This Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Madrid, Spain (for the City of
Manila), this 5th day of October, in the year of Our Lord,
nineteen hundred and fifty-one, and of the Independence
of the Philippines, the sixth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Assistant Executive Secretary
